summary: rtc_hosttest.c, compiled with a private copy of clock.c whose time between ticks lacks the PIT's position

argv: exec ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -g -O1 -ffreestanding -Wno-empty-body -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -DRTC_HOST_TEST -DRACH2_HOST_CPU -I rach2/sys -I rach2/sys/arch/x86 -I rach2/sys/arch/i686 -I rach2/sys/lib -I rach2/sys/proc -I tests/host/compat tests/host/rtc_hosttest.c ${SRC}/rach2/sys/clock.c rach2/sys/arch/x86/cmos.c rach2/sys/arch/x86/pit.c tests/host/compat/spinlock_host.c -o ${WORK}/rtc_hosttest
